questions.question: Why was the Samaritan woman surprised when Jesus asked her for a drink at Jacob's well?

answers.text: Jews did not associate with Samaritans
Men never came to draw at that well
She had no jar to draw water with

questions.question: Jesus told a Samaritan woman about the water He gives. What happens to whoever drinks it?

answers.text: They will thirst once a year
They will thirst a little less

questions.question: When the Samaritan woman at the well said the Messiah was coming, what did Jesus answer her?

answers.text: I who speak to you am He
He will come in many years
You will meet Him in Jerusalem
